newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Hock Seng gets Bakun pact.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Hock Seng gets Bakun pact.

text.p: Malaysia's Hock Seng Lee Bhd said it has secured contracts valued at 27.7 million ringgit to build access roads and bridges at the $5.5 billion Bakun hydroelectric dam site.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Thursday, the construction company said it will sign two contracts with Bintulu Port Sdn Bhd to build an access road for the port's container wharf.
The project also involves the construction of bridges, culvert, jetty, car park and port administrative buildings.
"It is the first of many (contracts from Bakun), we hope," Paul Yu Chee Hoe, managing director of Hock Seng said in the statement.
Construction on the Bakun dam, to be built in the jungles of the East Malaysia state of Sarawak on the island of Borneo, is scheduled to begin late this year or early in 1997.
